description: Reads or changes the geo targeting and session mode of a residential proxy. With only proxy_id it returns the current settings; any other parameter changes them. Free and reversible. Geo codes come from get_residential_locations; the backend ignores unknown codes and keeps the previous location. A change rewrites the provider login, and the response carries the updated http/socks5 connection strings. session_mode="rotating" gives a new IP per request; "sticky" holds one IP for session_time minutes (max 120).

session_time.description: Sticky session lifetime in minutes, 1-120 (only with session_mode="sticky")

name: set_residential_geo
title: Set residential geo and session mode
